schools.name: Okemos
schools.nickname: Wolves (formerly Chieftains, then Chiefs; changed to Wolves in early 2022)

state_titles.notes: QF W 66-52 Marysville; SF W 57-56 Ypsilanti Willow Run (https://michigan-football.com/bb/okemos.htm)
QF W 76-56 Flint Beecher; SF W 66-51 Menominee (https://michigan-football.com/bb/okemos.htm)

state_runner_ups.notes: First 2OT game in Class A Final history; Johnathon Jones scored 38, Anthony Ianni 23. QF W 55-47 (OT) Grand Rapids Northview; SF W 57-56 Orchard Lake St. Mary's; regional W 62-58 Holt, regional final W 56-48 Dexter (https://my.mhsaa.com/sports/bbb/06reg.htm). Coach per https://www.mhsaa.com/sports/boys-basketball/stories/changing-capital-guard

final_fours_detail.result: SF L 45-78 Muskegon Heights (QF W 48-43 Flint Beecher)
SF L 33-43 Oak Park (QF W 50-49 Fenton)
SF L 25-63 Detroit U-D Jesuit; Okemos entered 23-3; QF W 50-45 East Kentwood; coach Jeff Wonch; first Semifinal since 2006

notable_players.name: Johnathon Jones
notable_players.accolades: All-State first team; 4th in 2006 Mr. Basketball voting; 2006 McDonald's All-American nominee; multiple-time CAAC Player of the Year; 21.6 ppg as senior; 38 pts in 2006 Class A Final
notable_players.college: Oakland (2006-10); led NCAA D-I in assists per game 2008-09; first-team All-Summit 2010
notable_players.pro: Overseas: MBK Rieker Komarno, Fraport Skyliners, HKK Siroki, KK Igokea

notable_players.name: Travis Bader
notable_players.accolades: Lansing State Journal Player of the Year as a senior; MHSAA record book: .891 season FT% (90 of 101, 2008-09)
notable_players.college: Oakland (2010-14 per Wikipedia, after redshirt); passed JJ Redick for NCAA D-I career 3-pointers record (Feb 2014); Oakland HOF
notable_players.pro: ASVEL, Rio Grande Valley Vipers, Austin Spurs and clubs in Lithuania, Italy, Greece, Spain; Brooklyn Nets assistant coach (2024-)

notable_players.name: Chris Harrison-Docks
notable_players.accolades: Three-time first-team All-State; Okemos all-time leading scorer (1,426 pts at time of bio); MHSAA records: 396 career FTs made, 176 FTs made in 2011-12, 178 career 3-pointers

notable_players.name: Taylor Moton
notable_players.accolades: MHSAA record: 342 assists in a season (2011-12, 26 games)
notable_players.pro: NFL Carolina Panthers offensive tackle (2nd round, 2017)

notable_players.name: Conner George
notable_players.accolades: 23 ppg / 10.9 rpg as senior; MHSAA records: 174 FTs made in 2014-15, .807 career FT%
notable_players.college: Michigan State (2015-20): walk-on who redshirted in 2015-16, won the Tim Bograkos Walk-On Award in 2016-17 and earned a scholarship in 2017-18; Academic All-Big Ten; played in the 2019 NCAA Tournament

notable_players.name: Anthony Ianni
notable_players.accolades: Starter on 2006 Class A runner-up (9.5 ppg, 8.2 rpg, 3.1 bpg; 23 pts in Final)
notable_players.college: Grand Valley State, then Michigan State (2009-12); described as first D-I player with autism

notable_players.name: Evan Thomas
notable_players.accolades: Leading scorer of 2019 Division 1 semifinal team (17.3 ppg, 8.0 rpg)

notable_players.name: Joe Wenzel
notable_players.accolades: MHSAA record: 22 points in one quarter vs. St. Johns (1-23-96)

notable_coaches.name: Stan Stolz
notable_coaches.years: 35 seasons (son Dan took over in 1994-95, so likely ended 1993-94: inferred)
notable_coaches.notes: 490 wins; Class B state titles 1981 and 1982; 19 league, 11 district, 5 regional titles; Class B Coach of the Year 1980, 1984; BCAM Hall of Fame 1988; Okemos AD 23 years; Greater Lansing Area Sports HOF 1999

notable_coaches.name: Dan Stolz
notable_coaches.notes: Son of Stan; 428-99 career at Williamston and Okemos; 2006 Class A runner-up; moved Okemos into CAAC top division

notable_coaches.name: Jeff Wonch
notable_coaches.notes: Led Bath to 2007 Class C title; 101-58 through first six seasons at Okemos; 2019 D1 semifinal; listed as head coach on MaxPreps 2025-26

schools.name: Holt

state_titles.notes: First boys basketball state title. Final played March 19, 2005. Record and path per Ingham County resolution https://resolutions.ingham.org/storage/Portals/BC/2005/05-83.html

schools.name: Lansing Waverly

Path: district W 63-61 Grand Ledge; regional final W 68-61 Benton Harbor; QF W 72-61 Ann Arbor Pioneer; SF W 78-75 Saginaw (Taylor 31). Box score https://my.mhsaa.com/MHSAA_ARCHIVE/sports/bbb/00afinal.html ; path https://my.mhsaa.com/sports/bbb/2000reg.html

notable_players.pro: 2002 NBA Draft 2nd round (52nd) Minnesota; CBA, NBDL, France, Greece, Germany (2002-09)
